covers: Teeth, gums and mouth checked in one visit
X-rays when needed

services.description: A full look at your teeth, gums and mouth, with X-rays when needed.
services.good_to_know: Bring a list of any medicines you take and tell the dentist about any pain or sensitivity.
services.name: General Checkup

Teeth polished for a smooth, clean feel
Gum health checked during the visit
Tips to keep teeth clean between visits
services.description: Gentle removal of plaque and tartar, finished with a smooth polish.
services.good_to_know: Some sensitivity after cleaning is normal and usually settles in a day or two.
services.name: Teeth Cleaning

Gentle whitening treatment in the clinic
Shade checked with you before and after
Advice on keeping the result for longer
services.description: A brighter smile with a gentle whitening treatment, finished in the clinic.
services.good_to_know: Whitening is not right for every tooth, so the dentist checks first and tells you honestly what to expect.
services.name: Teeth Whitening

covers: Teeth and bite checked at the first visit
A straightening plan made for your teeth
Braces or clear aligners, as advised
Regular check ins while teeth move into place
services.description: Straighter teeth with braces or clear aligners, planned around your smile and your bite.
services.good_to_know: Straightening takes time. The dentist explains the plan and the visits before you start.
services.name: Braces and Aligners

covers: Mouth and bone checked before any plan is made
Implant plan explained step by step
A fixed crown fitted on the implant
Care advice for keeping the implant healthy
services.description: A fixed replacement for a missing tooth, planned carefully so it feels and works like a natural tooth.
services.good_to_know: Not every mouth is ready for an implant at once. The dentist checks first and explains the options.
services.name: Dental Implants

covers: The tooth checked and X-rayed first
The infection inside the tooth cleaned out
The tooth sealed and protected
A follow up to check the tooth has settled
services.description: Gentle treatment for a painful tooth, to remove the infection inside it and keep the tooth.
services.good_to_know: If a tooth hurts when you bite or drink something hot or cold, book a visit and do not wait for it to pass.
